name: shanku
description: Shanku: open, IFC-native structural modelling in the browser.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cad2bim/tokens && npm run build -w @cad2bim/ui && npm run build -w @cad2bim/playground && npm run build -w @cad2bim/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cad2bim/tokens && npm run dev -w @cad2bim/web
scripts.dev:playground: npm run build -w @cad2bim/tokens && npm run dev -w @cad2bim/playground
scripts.test: node tools/check-workspace-versions.mjs && npm run build -w @cad2bim/tokens && npm run test -w @cad2bim/ui && npm run test -w @cad2bim/engine && npm run test -w @cad2bim/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cad2bim/tokens && npm run typecheck -w @cad2bim/ui && npm run typecheck -w @cad2bim/engine && npm run typecheck -w @cad2bim/playground && npm run typecheck -w @cad2bim/web && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json
scripts.fixtures:showcase: python tools/fixtures/make_showcase_ifc.py tower apps/web/public/samples/g14-tower.ifc.gz && python tools/fixtures/make_showcase_ifc.py twin apps/web/public/samples/g24-twin-towers.ifc.gz
